modern: Things themselves do not touch the soul, not in the least; nor do they have any entry to the soul, nor can they turn or move the soul: but the soul turns and moves itself alone, and whatever judgements it sees fit to make, such it makes for itself the things which present themselves to it.
original: Things themselves touch not the soul, not in the least degree; nor have they admission to the soul, nor can they turn or move the soul: but the soul turns and moves itself alone, and whatever judgments it may think proper to make, such it makes for itself the things which present themselves to it.
